intuition: Store each token's expiry time and renew it only while it is still live.

brute_force.approach: Keep all token creation and renewal records, then scan them to determine the latest valid expiry.
brute_force.time: generate O(1), renew O(n), countUnexpiredTokens O(n)

optimal.approach: Map tokens to expiry times and use a min-heap of expiry events to lazily remove expired current versions.
optimal.time: generate O(log n), renew O(log n), countUnexpiredTokens O(x log n)
optimal.space: O(n) live tokens plus stale expiry events

edge_cases: A token expiring exactly at the current time is expired.
Renewing an absent or expired token has no effect.
